title: SRS is a file format designed to carry provenance (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
SRS is a file format designed to carry provenance.

What file formats could I embed SRS within?

File.srs.html
File.srs.pdf
File.srs.docx

If I created a rendered minutes document, I want them to be able to read the minutes, but an srs reader should also be able to see the transcript, the data that it was enriched with, an in-between topic map.
